title: Authentication failure burst
steps: Confirm the event source and verify its timestamp and timezone.
Review the linked events and determine whether the failures share a host, account, and source address.
Check approved change windows, service accounts, VPN or NAT context, and identity-provider records.
If the activity remains suspicious, document the account owner and affected system, then follow your organization's approved containment process.
Record evidence, decisions, approvals, and outcome in the case. Do not disable accounts or block network traffic from this application.

title: Failures followed by authentication success
scenario: Repeated failures followed by a success
steps: Validate the success and failure events against the source system and confirm the linked username and source address.
Check whether the successful session is expected for this user, host, time, and authentication method.
Review adjacent endpoint, VPN, and identity-provider evidence for additional context.
Escalate to the identity or endpoint owner when the sequence cannot be explained.
Document any proposed containment as a human-approved response action; BlueWatch never executes it.
